records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the three months ended March 31, 2022 and 2021, we recognized passenger revenue of $709 million and $237 million respectively, that was included in passenger travel liability at the beginning of the respective periods.

records.text: Interest expense recognized during the three months ended March 31, 2021 was insignificant.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total 401(k) company match, Retirement Plus, Retirement Advantage, pilot retirement contribution, and profit sharing expensed for the three months ended March 31, 2022 and 2021 was $62 million and $48 million, respectively.
